# 125: Nej tack till finanskris - men var börjar det skaka?

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-10-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts discuss the first real equity-market reaction to rising bond yields and widening credit spreads, and ask where a possible financial crisis could start. They point to French debt, AI-related borrowing and the narrow Wall Street rally. They see real estate, construction, small caps, trucks, consumer durables and autos as the sectors most sensitive to higher rates. Lighter topics include software bids as a read-across to Octave and Vitec, Verisure's weak listing, Intrum's slump, and a skeptical look at SBB's deals with PPI.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 KOPP-B — Kopparberg | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Wetherspoon's positive profit warning on full pub terraces is a read-across for Kopparberg's UK cider sales.

#### Reasoning

A host draws a read-across: JD Wetherspoon beat expectations thanks to a sunny late summer and full terraces. Kopparberg sells a lot of cider to UK pubs, so its next report could be good. This is speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the next report shows weak UK volumes

> *"Kopparberg som är noterat i Sverige de säljer ju väldigt mycket cider på brittiska uteserveringar, så om det går bra för puboperatören vem vet, kanske går det bra i nästa rapport."*

---

### 🟢 SHOT — Scandic Hotels | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Industry statistics show the hotel sector doing well, and the share has started to rise ahead of its report.

#### Reasoning

Hotel industry data is strong even though Scandic has not reported yet. A host concludes that one should own Scandic or a peer.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Scandic report disappoints
- if hotel industry data weakens

> *"Det tror jag också, så man borde äga Scandic eller Palm också."*

---

### ⛔ VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Called a big concern and an industry in crisis, with XC60 production problems, few registrations and debt concerns.

#### Reasoning

The hosts describe Volvo Cars as a sad story: production problems with the key XC60 model, very few cars registered, and worries about its debt in a crisis-hit European auto industry.

#### Sell Triggers

- if XC60 production normalises
- if registrations recover

> *"Volvo Cars är ju ett ganska stort bekymmer."*

---

### ⛔ SBB-B — SBB | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host distrusts SBB's governance. It sells assets to subsidiary PPI for shares at NAV instead of for cash. The share is falling.

#### Reasoning

A host voices deep distrust of SBB. The same chairman sits in SBB and PPI, and asset sales are paid in PPI shares at assumed NAV rather than market price. Cited critic Mikael Johansson would prefer cash sales. The market agrees and the share is down.

#### Sell Triggers

- if SBB sells assets for cash at good prices
- if the clean-up is completed with transparent governance

> *"Jag känner ju en djup misstro och skepsis mot SBB"*

---

### ⛔ VSURE — Verisure | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Called the world's worst big listing. Competition is rising, possibly from Apple, and its subscription sales are aggressive. A host holds it as a dud.

#### Reasoning

The hosts blame Verisure's weakness on competition and its aggressive subscription model, not on the stock exchange. A host owns it and regrets buying, and says he will announce when he sells.

#### Sell Triggers

- if competitive pressure eases
- if subscriber growth surprises positively

> *"Världens sämsta stora börsnotering."*

---

### ⛔ SKA-B — Skanska | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Rate sensitivity in its property development portfolio and less building as rates rise. The hosts say they have started to criticise it.

#### Reasoning

A US bank flagged Skanska's property development portfolio as rate-sensitive. The hosts cite a doom-loop argument: high rates mean less building, and they expect fewer projects.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates fall
- if the construction cycle turns up

> *"Men Skanska har åkt på en rejäl kyss."*

---

### 🟠 FOI-B — Fenix Outdoor | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Starting to rise after years in the wilderness. The Fjällräven brand has broad global appeal.

#### Reasoning

Hosts praise Fjällräven's appeal across socioeconomic groups and regions (Manhattan, Tokyo) and cheer the turnaround in the share.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the share's rise fades
- if brand demand weakens

> *"Hur kan det gå dåligt om man har en sån bredd? Frågar jag mig. Heja Fenix Outdoor!"*

---

### 🟠 VIT-B — Vitec | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Bids by Constellation and Schneider for beaten-down software companies suggest buyers value SaaS differently from the market.

#### Reasoning

Two bids on software companies that AI was supposed to kill suggest buyers value them above the market price. A host says this could be good for Vitec and Addnode.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI disruption fears intensify
- if bid activity dries up

> *"Det kanske kan vara lite bra för ett Vitec, eller ett Addnode, eller alla de här."*

---

### 🟠 ANOD-B — Addnode | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Possible beneficiary of M&A interest in beaten-down software companies.

#### Reasoning

Same read-across as for Vitec: bids on SaaS and product lifecycle software show buyers value these companies differently from the market.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI disruption fears intensify

> *"Det kanske kan vara lite bra för ett Vitec, eller ett Addnode, eller alla de här."*

---

### 🟠 INTRUM — Intrum | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down nearly 20% this week. An old short case, with a turnaround that few believe in.

#### Reasoning

Worst large stock of the week. The hosts had hoped for a turnaround under a CFO they like, but the slump continues, which suggests caution.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the share keeps falling
- if a key manager leaves for SEB

> *"Intrum, nästan 20% ned. Gammalt blanka case."*

---

### 🟠 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up 3% this week as the run continues, though not yet proven.

#### Reasoning

The hosts note its continued momentum but say it has not really proven itself yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the momentum reverses

> *"Man har inte riktigt bevis. visat sen, men det känns som att vinden är i ryggen va?"*

---
